t: The smallest country of mainland Central America, independent under its 1841 constitution after the federation collapsed.
Coffee built a powerful landowning elite; in 1932 the army’s Matanza crushed a peasant and indigenous revolt in the west.
Civil war in 1980–1992 killed about 75,000; peace, dollarisation and Nayib Bukele’s anti-gang crackdown followed.
dyk: El Salvador is the only Central American country with no Caribbean coastline: its whole shore, about 300 kilometres long, faces the Pacific Ocean.
ev: A constitution declares El Salvador a sovereign and independent state
